lesson.guided_practice:
PRACTISE BEFORE READING THE FEEDBACK
Write in numerals: four thousand and sixty-two. Write in words: 2,508.

FEEDBACK
4,062; two thousand five hundred and eight.

WATCH FOR
Writing 4,062 as four thousand six hundred two swaps tens and hundreds words.
lesson.independent_task:
INDEPENDENT EVIDENCE
Convert eight numbers both ways (words↔numerals) between 1,000 and 9,999, including zeros in different places. Mark hyphens in compound tens words such as forty-five.

Write a short reflection naming one step you corrected and why.
lesson.learning_intention: Reading and writing large numbers in words follows place groups: thousands, then the remaining hundreds/tens/ones, with conventional word forms.
materials: Optional: place-value chart or number line
lesson.offline_alternative: Use paper and pencil to complete the original task, then retain a photograph or short parent observation as evidence.
lesson.parent_notes:
Parent: Marking guidance for the independent task: Convert eight numbers both ways (words↔numerals) between 1,000 and 9,999, including zeros in different places. Mark hyphens in compound tens words such as forty-five. Accept equivalent original responses that show the same skill.

Parent: Written model 1: Original response on new material: 4,062; two thousand five hundred and eight. Reasoning: I used words by attending to numerals and explain why it matters rather than copying the worked model.

Parent: Written model 2: Common error: Writing 4,062 as four thousand six hundred two swaps tens and hundreds words. Correction: 4,062; two thousand five hundred and eight. Why: the correction restores accurate use of words.

Parent: Likely misconception: Writing 4,062 as four thousand six hundred two swaps tens and hundreds words. Keep sample answers out of the child role.

Parent: Short-answer focus 1: Solve one fresh problem that uses words with different numbers from the worked model. Show working and name the places or values that matter.

Parent: Short-answer focus 2: Describe one likely mistake with words, show corrected working, and say why the correction works.

Parent: Marking notes: Require new numbers, visible working and named places/values. / Require a real misconception, corrected working and a method reason..

WORKED MODEL

teach_steps.explain:
Reading and writing large numbers in words follows place groups: thousands, then the remaining hundreds/tens/ones, with conventional word forms.

WHY IT MATTERS
This helps the learner choose methods based on place value, quantity and accurate working, rather than guessing digits by shape alone. Keep every step justified.

HOW TO WORK
Read the worked example and name the places, values or distances that carry the method. Before looking at the correction, make your own attempt using the exact question provided. Compare your working with the feedback: did you use the same skill and show your reasoning? If a digit or place is uncertain, identify what would have to be regrouped or counted again. One deliberate, justified revision is more useful than writing a longer answer.
